interpretation: Addendum governs conflicts. Later established hold-Alt/MMB/auto-key decisions remain resolved. Conditional/suggested/OPEN text is not silently promoted into mandatory work.
evidence_policy: Source existence and recorded reports are not tests executed during this reconciliation. scoped_evidence means partial/profile-specific documented tests, not full acceptance closure. Earlier requirements matrix remains historical context.

scoring.method: After the checklist baseline has been audited, report implemented required_implementation items / all required_implementation items separately from verified required items / all required implementation+verification items. No partial credit. Exclude optional/decision/control records. External blockers stay in the acceptance denominator. Equal checklist units are not effort, reliability or release-readiness weights.
scoring.reason: Initial finite reconciliation; acceptance conditions need per-item closure/evidence audit. No numeric completion score is published yet. The earlier informal70percent is not this baseline.

requirements.title: Pinned offline development workflow
requirements.acceptance: A clean supported setup launches pinned Godot and detects Python/FFmpeg without a cloud application dependency.
requirements.remaining: Clean Windows installation is a separate acceptance gate.

requirements.title: Simple and Advanced share one document
requirements.acceptance: Switching UI detail preserves scene, timeline, camera, effective parameters and output; common tasks remain usable in Simple.
requirements.remaining: Full routed workflow and novice observation remain.

requirements.title: Home, recent projects and tutorials
requirements.acceptance: Home opens New, Tutorials and real recent projects with available thumbnails and actionable missing-file feedback.
requirements.remaining: Fresh complete Home interaction acceptance remains.

requirements.title: Empty world and editor grid
requirements.acceptance: New starts black with a fading white floor grid, no selected object, bottom timeline and hierarchy; the grid is excluded from final output.
requirements.remaining: Fresh routed empty-world/export gate remains.

requirements.title: Navigation, focus and shortcut routing
requirements.acceptance: Fly controls, stepping, Space and remapped shortcuts respect text focus/drawing mode and release capture on Escape/focus loss; alternate navigation stays optional.
requirements.remaining: Physical Windows device and complete routed focus matrix remain.

requirements.title: Common-format import and immutable sources
requirements.acceptance: Supported common files import into editable HAS world objects with dependency errors; drop uses frame0 and timeline import uses its chosen frame without modifying originals.
requirements.remaining: Full current common-format dependency/fault matrix and physical Explorer drop remain.

requirements.title: Native ecosystem coverage
requirements.acceptance: Source model/map containers, MMD model/motion/pose and VRM profiles have documented supported features, safe adapters and representative native acceptance evidence.
requirements.remaining: Approved complete native fixtures and associated tools are required; extension recognition alone is insufficient.

requirements.title: Native fidelity and dependency reporting
requirements.acceptance: Imported data uses the canonical HAS representation and cached preparations. For each supported profile verify geometry, materials, hierarchy, rig/morph/animation and supported physics/lightmaps; unsupported properties get actionable diagnostics.
requirements.remaining: Broader native material, inherited-transform, rig/cloth, prop/lightmap fidelity remains; retain original sources.

requirements.title: Visible spawn and bounded grounding
requirements.acceptance: Models spawn visibly near the captured view, attempt support/overlap avoidance with bounded candidates, and remain findable on fallback; maps are not treated as tiny humanoids.
requirements.remaining: Native bounds/orientation/scale and large-world acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Multiple maps, parenting and hierarchy
requirements.acceptance: Several maps/models/groups coexist, roots move whole maps, hierarchy finds distant objects, and parenting/saving preserve transforms.
requirements.remaining: Very large worlds and broader native hierarchy verification remain.

requirements.title: Selection, bones and hidden-object editing
requirements.acceptance: Selection shows an editor-only green outline, accessible bones and decided hold-Alt reveal; hidden-parent selection remains editable without changing output visibility.
requirements.remaining: Complete routed selection/context priority and native bone-binding acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Direct posing and automatic manual keys
requirements.acceptance: Root and bone edits key the intended object/part at the exact playhead, Undo restores them, and unrigged assets degrade gracefully.
requirements.remaining: Native transform/rig acceptance and full direct-manipulation ergonomics remain.

requirements.title: Rig-aware IK and foot constraints
requirements.acceptance: Supported hand/limb IK and planted-foot/root edits preserve reachable targets; unusual or missing rigs refuse safely.
requirements.remaining: Broader native rig chains and whole-body goal handling remain.

requirements.title: Reference-only posed characters
requirements.acceptance: Poseable references can be shown/hidden independently for preview versus final render, with saved pose interpolation and usable three-quarter inspection.
requirements.remaining: Fresh complete reference-only routed/export acceptance remains.

requirements.title: Reusable body poses
requirements.acceptance: Named thumbnail poses support use, rename, duplicate, removal and compatible native pose sharing without overwriting source rigs.
requirements.remaining: Native fixture breadth and artist acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Sparse interpolation and per-channel editing
requirements.acceptance: Hold/linear/ease and supported Advanced curves preserve authored endpoints, independent parameters and camera cuts during seek/save/export.
requirements.remaining: Complete supported-channel regression and artistic motion preference evaluation remain.

requirements.title: Reversible Motion Assist
requirements.acceptance: A simple assist control offers editable, disableable corrections without silently replacing authored poses; supported parts/helpers have explicit bounds.
requirements.remaining: Broader full-body assistance and owner intensity evaluation remain.

requirements.title: Reusable paths with locomotion assistance
requirements.acceptance: Reusable editable paths/clips can drive a character, with a visible reversible locomotion suggestion and correction workflow.
requirements.remaining: Optional saved/correctable walking on bounded straight flat paths now passes staged preview/cancel, Undo/Redo, recovery, packed cold Open and exact export checks. General rig/terrain/turning coverage and native/artist acceptance remain incomplete.

requirements.title: Shot camera authoring and cuts
requirements.acceptance: Temporary navigation is separate from explicit shot keys; numeric transforms/FOV, interpolation and adjacent-frame cuts persist and render at exact frames.
requirements.remaining: Complete routed camera matrix and Windows input acceptance remain.

requirements.title: One rational frame domain
requirements.acceptance: Camera, poses, drawings, media and sound use integer frames and rational rates; seek/preview/export agree and timing edits protect existing content.
requirements.remaining: Full rate/domain regression remains; output dimensions have their own requirement.

requirements.title: Collapsed tracks and animated subtracks
requirements.acceptance: Objects begin collapsed, expansion shows animated parts, and selecting parts focuses their channels without exposing inactive rig clutter by default.
requirements.remaining: Large-project track density and full routed coverage remain.

requirements.title: Structural clip and drawing edits
requirements.acceptance: Move/cut/copy/paste/split retain relative animation or independent cel pixels and have correct Undo; frame3000-to0 is supported.
requirements.remaining: Retain bounded current contracts; do not silently decide unresolved ripple/cross-track semantics.

requirements.title: Timeline navigation and waveforms
requirements.acceptance: Zoom/pan/seek share a ruler and frame mapping, labels stay fixed, scroll-to-playhead works and sound waveforms remain aligned.
requirements.remaining: Dense-project responsiveness and physical input acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Presence, persistent visibility and gaps
requirements.acceptance: Late introduction is absent beforehand; later clips do not override an explicit OFF; parent visibility, held/bridged gaps and global300ms/zero fades remain deterministic.

requirements.title: Independent RGBA layers
requirements.acceptance: Rough/Ink/Flats/Effects, order/visibility/opacity and painting remain independent from the world/camera and reproduce after saving and export.
requirements.remaining: Routed complete-layer acceptance remains; preserve current documented limits.

requirements.title: Editable held cels
requirements.acceptance: Blank/copy/delete/move/resize/split exposures obey end-exclusive boundaries and preserve independent editable pixels, Undo and persistence.
requirements.remaining: Long/dense raster storage is a separate missing capability.

requirements.title: Brush, eraser and pressure
requirements.acceptance: Output-coordinate strokes, opacity, erasing and supported pressure events remain correct under zoom/pan and Undo.
requirements.remaining: Physical Windows tablet behavior/latency remains externally unverified; no universal Ink/Wintab claim.

requirements.acceptance: Iterative fill supports tolerance, connectivity, visible-ink sampling, gap preview and border growth; application is undoable and never edits invisible peers or the scene.
requirements.remaining: Broader anti-aliased artistic-quality evaluation remains.

requirements.remaining: Full current routed color/guide regression remains.

requirements.remaining: Full current media fault/relink matrix remains.

requirements.remaining: Physical output-device sync/latency and complete fault matrix remain.

requirements.title: Live physics, freeze and reset
requirements.acceptance: Compatible bodies default to enabled physics when supported, simulate/grab/throw, freeze in the current pose when disabled and offer reset; simulation alone authors no take.
requirements.remaining: Native joints/cloth/helper fidelity and artist/device acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Explicit Local and World capture
requirements.acceptance: Visible explicit recording captures only selected Local bodies or all relevant World bodies; committed motion reproduces in seek/save/export and cancellation is safe.
requirements.remaining: Native cross-ecosystem scenarioD acceptance remains; compression algorithm is a separate suggestion.

requirements.title: Unshaded and lit presentation
requirements.acceptance: Unshaded is usable for posing; Lit uses supported scene lighting and retained compatible map lighting, with safe navigation and persisted output settings.
requirements.remaining: Native materials/lightmaps and target GPU quality remain.

requirements.title: Editable nested sequence assets
requirements.acceptance: Shared editable child scenes support local/parent mapping, offset/loop/placement/opacity, recursive audio and cache invalidation; cycles are rejected and parents update.
requirements.remaining: Large-project budgets and native/artist acceptance remain.

requirements.title: Alpha media and chroma compositing

requirements.title: Placed overlays and simple2D effects
requirements.acceptance: Multiple editable character/clip overlays support keyed transform/opacity placement and a simple2D shadow or glow without modifying the background.

requirements.title: Portable HAS and optional linked assets
requirements.acceptance: Default packed HAS retains editable world/rig/camera/cels/audio/settings and reopens with sources unavailable; linked saves offer actionable missing-file location.

requirements.title: Independent native model/map sharing

requirements.title: Project content versus personal preferences
requirements.acceptance: Project content/settings reproduce the scene while personal input/UI preferences stay personal; loading introduces no tentative disruptive settings prompt.
requirements.remaining: Complete project/personal setting matrix remains; prompt policy stays tentative.

requirements.title: Validated atomic save and fault safety
requirements.acceptance: Corrupt/unsafe/missing assets and failed/interrupted writes cannot replace the sole valid project or escape its folder; backup/readback/integrity faults are exercised.

requirements.title: Quiet time/action autosave

requirements.remaining: Long-session resource/latency measurement remains.

requirements.title: Bounded journal and Advanced history

requirements.remaining: Shared-asset cleanup, concurrent sessions and measured long-session behavior remain.

requirements.title: Automatic newest-valid recovery

requirements.remaining: Native Windows/hardware fault gate remains; Linux procedural cases are scoped evidence.

decisions.title: Independent native package contract

decisions.title: Multi-projection3D path inference
decisions.question: Accuracy, depth inference, additional-view request and correction rules remain undecided. Authored paths and reversible locomotion assistance can proceed independently.

decisions.title: Assist intensity preference

decisions.title: Extra per-key fades, load-settings prompt and tutorial Skip
decisions.question: Do not introduce these as mandatory features or disruptive dialogs without a decision.

decisions.title: Application/public-distribution license
decisions.question: Owner chooses distribution/license terms before publishing; no publishing or native-art redistribution is authorized by this development goal.
